Japanese.hint: 一輪車を自分で組み立てる必要があるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about commercial contractor account registration steps
tasks.hint: Ask how to open a pro contractor account.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about commercial contractor account registration steps.

Japanese.goal: 業者向けアカウントの登録手続きについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: プロ向けの業者アカウントの作り方を聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if PVC pipe cement requires separate primer application
tasks.hint: Inquire if PVC glue needs primer first.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if PVC pipe cement requires separate primer.

Japanese.goal: 塩ビ管用の接着剤に別途プライマーが必要か尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 塩ビ管用の接着剤の前にプライマーを塗る必要があるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Check if store has magnetic stud finders in stock
tasks.hint: Ask if magnetic stud finders are on shelves.
tasks.done_when: Learner checked if store has magnetic stud finders in stock.

Japanese.goal: 磁石式の下地センサーの在庫があるか確認する
Japanese.hint: 磁石式の下地センサーが店頭にあるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Review itemized hardware store receipt for correct SKU pricing
tasks.hint: Examine receipt line items and prices before leaving.
tasks.done_when: Learner reviewed itemized hardware receipt for correct SKU pricing.
tasks.scene_hint: Heavy rubber floor mats lead toward contractor checkout lanes.

Japanese.goal: 明細付きのレシートで商品コードごとの価格が正しいか確認する
Japanese.hint: 店を出る前に、レシートの各項目と価格をよく確認しましょう。

tasks.goal: Request a tax-exempt business invoice for commercial contracting job
tasks.hint: Ask for tax-exempt receipt with business tax ID.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested tax-exempt business invoice for contractor job.

Japanese.goal: 業務用の工事のために免税の請求書をお願いする
Japanese.hint: 事業者の納税番号を記載した免税の領収書がほしいと伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask cashier for lumber yard loading pass ticket before driving around
tasks.hint: Inquire about getting a drive-in lumber yard pass.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked cashier for lumber yard loading pass ticket.

Japanese.goal: 資材置き場に車で入る前に、レジで積み込み用の入場券をもらう
Japanese.hint: 車で入れる資材置き場の入場券のもらい方を聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about store return window duration for unused plumbing supplies
tasks.hint: Ask how many days you have to return unused parts.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about store return window for plumbing supplies.

Japanese.goal: 使わなかった配管部品を返品できる期間を尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 未使用の部品を何日以内なら返品できるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm total payment amount before accepting receipt copy
tasks.hint: Verify total charge before taking receipt.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed total payment amount before accepting receipt.

Japanese.goal: レシートの控えを受け取る前に支払い総額を確認する
Japanese.hint: レシートを受け取る前に、合計金額を確認しましょう。

tasks.goal: Thank the hardware associate for expert project advice and guidance
tasks.hint: Express gratitude to store associate before leaving.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked hardware associate for project advice and guidance.
tasks.scene_hint: Barcode scanners beep rapidly at busy hardware checkout registers.

Japanese.goal: 作業について専門的なアドバイスをくれた店員にお礼を言う
Japanese.hint: 帰る前に店員に感謝の気持ちを伝えましょう。

name_translations.Japanese: ホームセンターで買い物
